title: Street Fighter II
match: Street Fighter II: The World Warrior
Street Fighter II - The World Warrior

cards.title: CONTROLS
cards.text:
Stick: walk, jump, crouch. Hold away from the opponent to block.
Top row: light / medium / heavy PUNCH
Bottom row: light / medium / heavy KICK

cards.title: MOTIONS
cards.text:
QCF: down, down-forward, forward
DP: forward, down, down-forward
Charge: hold back 2 s, then forward
Specials = motion + punch or kick

cards.title: CREDITS
cards.text:
1 COIN = 1 CREDIT
2P: PRESS START
TO CHALLENGE
